title: Suboccipital Inhibition in Tension Headache
brief_summary: The researchers will carry out a randomized experimental study. Participants in the experimental group will receive a treatment based on suboccipital inhibition technique in addition to conventional treatment. Participants in the control group will only receive the conventional treatment. The existence of significant differences in both groups will be analyzed.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* pathology tension headache associated with cervicalgia

Exclusion Criteria:

* pathology of nervous system
